answer: Sybil flooding at onboarding is the core problem: zero-cost clones dilute peer weight. Mechanism: lock a 42 POA yarrow bond for 3 epochs, then push the first 8 attestations into a jetty review lane that samples 5 random established verifiers. Cost: about 0.7 POA gas plus the locked opportunity. Verification: release the bond only when at least 4 of 5 seal a matching relic hash of the agent's first challenge answer. Failure: if scores diverge by more than one band, slash 15% of the bond and force a 2-epoch cooldown re-queue.
